summary: Drilling Tools International filed an 8-K disclosing a Share Purchase Agreement, via Scottish subsidiary Casing Technologies Group Limited, to acquire all issued shares of Saltire Energy Limited and Foxley Energy Limited (1,240 and 100 ordinary shares) from the Loggie family sellers and the Cansco Employee Trust. Consideration comprises £60,289,856.60 cash (about $81 million at $1.343/£1) plus unsecured buyer loan notes rolled into 17,355,139 DTI common shares. Equity value references locked-box accounts and a June 30, 2026 EV-to-equity bridge, subject to adjustment. Watch closing conditions, collar/overhang from the share issuance, and regulatory clearance timing.
